maintenance_led.reason: Refines and sells fuels and asphalt, which are consumables used up in operation, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells gasoline, diesel, jet and marine fuels to commercial, wholesale and retail buyers; government asphalt buyers are a minor share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly from owning and running refineries and logistics; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Refined fuels are largely commodity products bought on price, though remote island markets like Hawaii limit alternatives.

notes: Hawaii refining and retail markets are logistically isolated, which may make switching harder than for typical fuel suppliers.
